To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a framework for in-network processing of IoT data, whereby we map operations of an artificial network to the communication within an IoT network.

we have shown the possibility of using the communication of IoT to serve the data processing of the IoT, and that the communication can be shaped by the network to achieve the desired data processing.

we have demonstrated that the communication within an IoT network can be used to realize an artificial neural network for data processing and transfer, which reduces the latency in the delivery of processed information and supports local processing of information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the realization of in-network computing for the IoT.
a novel approach to data processing that leverages the inherent structure of the IoT.
the design and implementation of in-network computing for the Internet of things.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the paper presents an element in the evolution of a new computing paradigm, in-network computation, which leverages the IoT network to serve data processing and communication simultaneously.

this work is a first step in the development of an approach to in-network computation that leverages the communication of the IoT to perform data processing, rather than treating the communication of the network as simply a means of data delivery.
we present a novel method for performing neural network computations in-network, leveraging the communication of an ultra-dense IoT network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IoT network is a neural network, and the neural network is an IoT network.
this paper presents a novel realization of in-network processing in the context of IoT.
the proposed approach can be used for in-network data processing and transfer in IoT networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we demonstrate the feasibility of using the communication of a network for data processing, which is a key step toward realizing the potential of in-network computation.
we can treat the IoT network as a single entity that can be used for both communication and computation.
IoT devices and their communication can be leveraged to serve as a distributed data processing engine, and we present a framework to achieve this goal.
